title: Restricted coefficient projection equals the constant-tensor projection
statement: For a homomorphism a:C→D of commutative rings, a scheme morphism f:X→Y and a compactification c, let V=D[0] as a C-complex. Identify U^W T^W K with V_W tensor K by the normalized scalar/tensor isomorphism, constant-sheaf comparison, exact descent of the single complex and signed symmetry [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings, lem-pur-change-of-rings-tensor-comparison]. The restriction of compactScalarMap(a,c), followed by singleRestriction(a,c) [def-pur-etale-system-projection-data] and the tensor identification on X, equals the tensor identification on Y followed by exceptionalConstantProjectionMap(C,c,V,K) [lem-pur-etale-exceptional-constant-tensor]. This holds on the whole unbounded categories, without finiteness, flatness or Tor bounds.

source.place: Proposition 2.29(2) and Construction 2.26, printed pp. 15–16; the coefficient projection calculation in step 2 of lem-pur-etale-system-quotient-normalization. Stacks more-etale.tex Tag 0GL6 supplies the proper/open coefficient construction.

proof.text: Write c=(j,p). Expand compactScalarMap as the proper coefficient mate followed by Rp_* of the open balancing isomorphism. Expand singleRestriction as the restriction/proper-image mate followed by Rp_* of the inverse open/restriction isomorphism. The normalized scalar/tensor comparison identifies U T with tensor by D[0]. The proved proper/open factorization declaration is used for this expansion.

For the proper factor, transpose through p^* dashv Rp_*. The scalar/pullback comparison on K-flat representatives is the tensor/pullback comparison retaining the D factor. The defining counit equation for the scalar mate gives the usual proper projection morphism followed by the coefficient pullback identification. This is an equality of the specified maps, with no boundedness or flatness assumption.

For the open factor take j_! dashv j^* adjuncts of the two proposed maps. The open/restriction comparison is the mate of the restriction/pullback comparison. The inverse open scalar isomorphism is the mate of the inverse scalar/pullback comparison. Thus the restricted tensor/pullback square, with naturality of the open unit, identifies the two adjuncts. Adjunction injectivity gives the open projection inverse with the coefficient pullback factor. This also handles non-quasi-compact opens.

Paste the proper and open identities using naturality of the restriction/proper-image mate. The pullback of the constant complex is its canonical constant-sheaf pullback; the constant comparisons respect composition and exact localization. The two signed symmetries change tensor order to coefficient first and cancel by involutivity. The resulting composite is exactly exceptionalConstantProjectionMap, giving the asserted equality. Identity ring maps, zero rings, the empty scheme and identity compactifications all use these same unit and counit equations; no cancellation by a noninvertible coefficient map occurs.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleQuotientTensorProjection
    {C D : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing C] [CommRing D] (a : C →+* D)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule C X) :
  let V := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} C) 0).obj
    ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars a).obj (ModuleCat.of D D))
  let e (W : Scheme.{u}) (L : DerivedCategoryModule C W) :=
    (scalarTensorIso a W).app L ≪≫
      ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} C) W).obj L).mapIso
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).mapIso
          ((constantCommuteCompose W.smallEtaleTopology
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars a)).app (ModuleCat.of D D)) ≪≫
          (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor
            (constantSheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} C)) 0).symm.app
              ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars a).obj (ModuleCat.of D D))) ≪≫
      ((derivedTensorSymmetry (ModuleCat.{u + 1} C) W).app L).app
        ((constantSheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} C)).mapDerivedCategory.obj V)
  (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars Y.smallEtaleTopology a).map
      ((compactScalarMap a c).app K) ≫
    (SystemProjection.singleRestriction (CommRingCat.ofHom a) c).app
      ((scalarExtension a X).obj K) ≫
    (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} C) c).map
      (e X K).hom =
  (e Y ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} C) c).obj K)).hom ≫
    exceptionalConstantProjectionMap C c V K
